overview_description: Create, preview, change and delete bookings, and read their lines, billing, invoices, payments and PDFs.
intro: A booking is an order whose lines reserve a labour for set booking times. These endpoints create, preview, change and delete bookings, and read and update their lines, billing preferences, invoices, payments, fulfillments, custom objects and PDFs. The module has 33 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Delete a booking removes whatever order has that `id`, of any type, and returns no body.** Check the `id` first: a read of it afterwards returns `404`.
notes: **The `/booking/{booking_id}` reads, updates and delete work on any order.** They do not check the order's type. Change a booking and Preview a booking change accept only a booking-type order.
**Each line of a new booking needs a labour and its booking times.** The rest of the body is the order body, under `order`: `account_id`, `name` and `lines`.
**Most bodies sit under `order`; the change bodies sit under `booking`.** The line billing update takes `order.line.item_properties`, not `billing_preferences`.
**Updates return the whole booking under `order`.** Single reads use their own keys: `order_line`, `custom_object`, `item_fulfillment`, `order_kpis` and `payment`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records are under `data`; pass `limit` and the previous page's `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor`, and stop when `has_more` is `false`.
**There is no per-booking notes listing.** List booking notes returns the notes of every order, and `/booking/{booking_id}/notes` is refused.

endpoints.title: List bookings
endpoints.summary: Lists bookings one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of bookings under `data`, with a `pagination` block. Pass `limit` to set the page size and `cursor` to move to the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality and `filter_<field>_<operator>` otherwise.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking
endpoints.summary: Returns one booking with its lines, billing preferences and KPIs.
endpoints.description: Returns the booking under `order`, including its `lines`, `billing_preferences`, `custom_attributes` and `kpis`. This path serves any order, not only booking-type orders.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

404.description: No order has that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Create a booking
endpoints.summary: Creates a booking and returns it under `booking`.
endpoints.description: Send the same body as creating an order, under `order`: the `account_id`, an optional `name` and the `lines`. Each line needs a labour and its booking times. The new booking comes back under `booking`.

endpoints.title: Preview a booking
endpoints.summary: Prices a booking without creating it.
endpoints.description: Takes the same body as Create a booking and creates nothing. The result comes back under `booking` and holds only an empty `activity_logs` list, with no cart data.

201.description: The preview, under `booking`, holding an empty `activity_logs` list.

endpoints.title: Delete a booking
endpoints.summary: Deletes a booking and returns no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the order with this `id`, whatever its type, so check the `id` before you call it. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

204.description: The order is deleted. There is no body.

endpoints.title: List booking notes
endpoints.summary: Lists the notes of every order, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of notes under `data`, the same list as the order notes listing. There is no per-booking notes listing: `/booking/{booking_id}/notes` is refused. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality and `filter_<field>_<operator>` otherwise.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking's billing preferences
endpoints.summary: Returns a booking's billing preferences under `order.billing_preferences`.
endpoints.description: Returns the invoice, payment and fulfillment settings of one booking, such as `invoice_mode`, `payment_term` and `billing_period`, under `order.billing_preferences`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: Update a booking's billing preferences
endpoints.summary: Changes a booking's billing preferences and returns the whole booking.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `order.billing_preferences`, such as `invoice_mode`. The whole booking comes back under `order`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: Change a booking
endpoints.summary: Changes a booking from an effective date.
endpoints.description: Send `effective_date` and `lines` under `booking`, not `order`. Only a booking-type order is accepted. Change is the only transition this path offers.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: Preview a booking change
endpoints.summary: Shows the result of a booking change without making it.
endpoints.description: Takes the same body as Change a booking, under `booking`, and changes nothing. Only a booking-type order is accepted.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking's information
endpoints.summary: Returns a booking's header under `order`.
endpoints.description: Returns the booking's header details, such as `name`, `description`, `status` and `account`, under `order`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: Update a booking's information
endpoints.summary: Changes a booking's header and returns the whole booking.
endpoints.description: Send the header fields to change under `order`, such as `description`. The whole booking comes back under `order`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking's lines
endpoints.summary: Returns a booking with its lines under `order.lines`.
endpoints.description: Returns the booking under `order`, with every line in `lines`. Each line carries its item, quantity, price, tax and totals.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

200.description: The booking with its lines, under `order`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking line
endpoints.summary: Returns one line of a booking under `order_line`.
endpoints.description: Returns the line with its item, quantity, price snapshot, tax and `item_properties`, under `order_line`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: line_uuid
parameters.description: The `id` of one of the booking's `lines`.

endpoints.title: Update a booking line
endpoints.summary: Changes one line of a booking and returns the whole booking.
endpoints.description: Send the line fields to change under `order.line`, such as `item_description`. The whole booking comes back under `order`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: line_uuid
parameters.description: The `id` of one of the booking's `lines`.

endpoints.title: Update a booking line's billing preferences
endpoints.summary: Changes the billing settings of one line and returns the whole booking.
endpoints.description: Send the settings under `order.line.item_properties`, not under `billing_preferences`, such as `charging_start_date`. The example targets a metered line. The whole booking comes back under `order`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: line_uuid
parameters.description: The `id` of one of the booking's `lines`.

parameters.name: custom_object_id

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: List a booking's item fulfillments
endpoints.summary: Lists the item fulfillments of a booking, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of fulfillments under `data`, with a `pagination` block. A booking with no fulfillment returns an empty `data` list. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality and `filter_<field>_<operator>` otherwise.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking item fulfillment
endpoints.summary: Returns one item fulfillment under `item_fulfillment`.
endpoints.description: Returns the fulfillment with its `fulfillments` lines, status and tracking number. The server does not check that the fulfillment belongs to the booking in the path.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: fulfillment_id
parameters.description: The item fulfillment's `id`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking's KPIs
endpoints.summary: Returns a booking's key figures under `order_kpis`.
endpoints.description: Returns figures such as `total_revenue`, `total_collected`, `total_outstanding` and `monthly_recurring_revenue`, under `order_kpis`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: List a booking's payment methods
endpoints.summary: Lists the payment methods bound to a booking.
endpoints.description: Returns the account payment methods restricted to this booking, under `order.payment_methods`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

404.description: No payment method is bound to the booking.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking payment method
endpoints.summary: Returns one payment method bound to a booking, found by its reference.
endpoints.description: Returns the payment method whose `reference` matches, under `order.payment_method`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: payment_method_ref
parameters.description: The payment method's `reference`, not its `id`.

endpoints.title: List a booking's payments
endpoints.summary: Lists the payments made against a booking's invoices, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of payments under `data`. Each payment lists the invoices it applies to and how it is applied. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality and `filter_<field>_<operator>` otherwise.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking payment
endpoints.summary: Returns one payment under `payment`.
endpoints.description: Returns the payment with its applied amounts and invoices. The server does not check that the payment belongs to the booking in the path.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: payment_id
parameters.description: The payment's `id`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking's PDF links
endpoints.summary: Returns links to a booking's PDF under `order.pdf`.
endpoints.description: Returns `download_url`, `preview_url` and `file_size` for the booking's PDF, under `order.pdf`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: List a booking's quote partial invoices
endpoints.summary: Lists the deposit and instalment invoices of a converted quote.
endpoints.description: Returns the deposit and instalment invoices under `order.partial_invoices`. The list is empty for a booking that did not start as a quote.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a booking shipping line PDF
endpoints.summary: Returns the PDF of one shipping line of a booking.
endpoints.description: Returns the generated shipping PDF of the line. Until the line has a generated shipping PDF, the call returns `404`.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking's `id`. Any order's `id` works here, whatever the order's type.

parameters.name: shipping_line_id
parameters.description: The shipping line's `id`.

404.description: The shipping line has no generated shipping PDF yet.

activity_logs.description: Returned by the writes, not by the reads, and empty in every response read.

value.description: A string or a list; both appear in responses.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust it over `next_cursor`, which can be stale on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` to read the next page.

records.description: Offset pages only: total matching records, not the page's length.

next_page.description: Offset pages only: the literal string `NULL` at the end of a listing, not JSON null.
